coverage.note: Bounded November 17–18 collection. Fifteen source-reviewed reports retain original event dates and distinguish company statements, official policy, Reuters reporting and an unreviewed research preprint. OpenAI background-mode changelog timing and EFF original publication date remain unresolved, so two news candidates are deferred. Five technologies and three terms await catalog and license/alias review; no catalog additions implied. Eighteen sources checked, two failures. Coverage remains partial.

tldr: OpenAI and Microsoft announced new coding and agent models, while GitHub expanded agent evaluation, review and enterprise oversight; pricing, access and benchmark outcomes remain source-dependent.

New York created an AI enforcement unit, Reuters reported shifts in accelerator shipments and model distillation, and a research preprint explored directly programmed sparse memories. Coverage is partial, with two news candidates and eight catalog proposals deferred.

news.title: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
news.summary: OpenAI announced Astra for complex professional agent tasks and Sol for lower-cost routine work, with API support and a deployment safety assessment.
news.why_it_matters: Offers differentiated quality-versus-cost choices for agent orchestration.
news.caveat: Benchmarks and capability thresholds are OpenAI-reported; access and safety restrictions vary.

news.title: OpenAI reports NATO defensive cybersecurity deployments
news.summary: OpenAI described supplying cybersecurity models and supporting NATO's 2026 Crossed Swords exercise involving supervised AI cyber agents.
news.why_it_matters: Shows the practical need for human authorization and boundaries in defensive agent systems.
news.caveat: The exercise predates the article; effectiveness figures are company-reported.

news.title: Microsoft releases MAI Code 2 and Code 2 Flash
news.summary: Microsoft announced Code 2 for complex, multi-file coding and Flash for faster high-volume coding, with GitHub Copilot client availability under plan conditions.
news.why_it_matters: Workload-specific coding models may reduce cost and response time.
news.caveat: Vendor benchmark claims are not independent; no downloadable weights or local runtime verified.

news.title: Ignite outlines Copilot Workspaces and Microsoft IQ
news.summary: Microsoft's Ignite keynote introduced shared human-agent workspace concepts and organizational context tooling alongside infrastructure updates such as Cobalt 200 general availability.
news.why_it_matters: Enterprise agents increasingly need persistent context and governance controls.
news.caveat: Keynote mixes shipping releases and roadmap intentions; feature availability differs.

news.title: GitHub Copilot Evals enters public preview
news.summary: GitHub's task-based evaluator lets eligible developers test custom agents, skills, and MCP tools, inspect outcomes and traces, and compare repeated runs.
news.why_it_matters: Repeatable tests reveal regressions single-chat examples miss.
news.caveat: Test definitions and harness settings affect outcomes; a pass is not a safety guarantee.

news.title: Copilot Fusion expands routing, clients and model options
news.summary: GitHub expanded its multi-model Copilot Fusion execution experience across supported clients, including beta mobile, and published coding benchmark comparisons.
news.why_it_matters: Harness and model coordination may change the cost and reliability of coding agents.
news.caveat: Vendor benchmark figures are harness-specific and mobile access is not universal.

news.title: GitHub previews on-demand secret scanning in agent code review
news.summary: GitHub introduced opt-in scanning using credential patterns and contextual ML detection during supported Copilot review workflows.
news.why_it_matters: Can check agent-generated changes for accidental secrets before integration.
news.caveat: Preview feature only covers selected changed content; consumes credits and can miss credentials.

news.title: Copilot reviews now vary effort by pull-request risk
news.summary: GitHub previews Lite, Balanced and Max review effort selected by pull-request complexity and optional cross-repository public code context.
news.why_it_matters: Review resources can be concentrated on complex changes.
news.caveat: Automation is fallible; administrators and developers must independently verify flagged risks.

news.title: GitHub adds enterprise Copilot activity export to Agent 365
news.summary: Eligible GitHub Enterprise Cloud organizations can export supported Copilot prompts, responses and tool-call logs to Microsoft's Agent 365 oversight system.
news.why_it_matters: Structured agent traces can aid incident investigation and oversight.
news.caveat: Available only for specified Enterprise Managed Users; privacy and retention require review.

news.title: GitHub benchmarks compare coding-agent harnesses
news.summary: GitHub's preview benchmarks add science tasks and harness-by-harness success and cost comparisons with model and effort controls.
news.why_it_matters: Separates some execution-environment effects from model-level quality.
news.caveat: Test environments and selected tasks may not represent real production workloads.

news.title: New York attorney general establishes AI enforcement unit
news.summary: New York announced an AI Safety, Standards, Enforcement and Transparency unit to support investigations and implementation of the RAISE Act.
news.why_it_matters: Creates a dedicated oversight and enforcement function for AI safety.
news.caveat: The law's specified effective date is January 1, 2027; announcement is not proof of any company violation.

news.title: Reuters reports Nvidia halted further licensed Hopper China shipments
news.summary: Reuters quoted Nvidia's interim chief executive saying no further approved Hopper datacenter-chip shipments to China are planned after past licensed sales.
news.why_it_matters: Export policy affects available AI accelerator supply and compute costs.
news.caveat: Future duration and cause were not independently established; prior shipment volume is not a future commitment.

news.title: Reuters examines Chinese companies' distillation of US AI models
news.summary: Reuters reviewed hundreds of records documenting attempts to use large American models' outputs to train local alternatives.
news.why_it_matters: Highlights economic incentives and policy disputes around teacher-model access.
news.caveat: Distillation is a legitimate technique; the report does not establish universal contract or legal violations.

news.title: PyTorch cancels v2.15.1 patch release
news.summary: Maintainers said PyTorch 2.15.1 will not ship; work is being redirected toward the planned 2.16.0 release.
news.why_it_matters: Dependency managers can adjust planned compatibility tests.
news.caveat: December 17 target for 2.16.0 is a plan and not a shipping guarantee.

news.title: Preprint explores language models writing sparse model weights
news.summary: Ok and Lee report that frontier model agents can construct narrow associative-memory systems directly from examples rather than training Transformers end to end.
news.why_it_matters: Suggests an interpretable route for constrained small-model design.
news.caveat: Small multiple-choice tests and author-reported results do not demonstrate a general-purpose LLM replacement.
